assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for a twilight faerie-court fantasy roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The frame is four straight narrow rails made of two or three twined slender stems of pale polished silver, wound with thread-fine gossamer strands and beaded with tiny pearls, with a few small five-petalled dusk-rose and blush-pink blossoms spaced sparingly along the rails; at each of the four corners a round open blossom rosette of layered rose-pink petals around a pearl centre, set in a ring of pale silverwork, each rosette perfectly round and symmetric. Material depth, soft dimensional highlights on the silver, delicate translucent petals: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic fantasy strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each rail stays narrow, within the outer 10 percent of the image; corner rosettes may fill the outer 17 percent. Keep the middle stretches of all four rails simple and continuous so they can stretch in a responsive UI. BACKGROUND: the large rectangular central opening (the central 66 percent in each dimension) and the thin space outside the frame must be filled with perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma green #00FF00, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient and no ornaments crossing it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 3 percent green outer margin; nothing cropped. Do not use green anywhere in the frame itself: no green leaves, stems are silver only. Soft neutral top-left light; pale silver, pearl white, dusk rose, blush pink, a touch of violet shadow. No oak, no ivy, no carved wood, no brass, no gold, no stars. No words, no letters, no runes, no buttons, no icons, no scenery, no creatures, no watermark.

Output 1024 square.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production wide 3:1 landscape banner artwork for a twilight faerie fantasy game's campaign lobby. Hand-painted premium strategy-game environment art with atmospheric depth. A quiet woodland glade at rose and violet dusk: on the right third, a ring of tall glowing mushrooms with softly luminous pale green-gold caps around a low mossy mound, beneath slender pale-barked blossom trees whose rose-pink petals drift on the air; fine gossamer threads beaded with dew strung between branches catch the last light; small firefly motes float through the scene; a calm open clearing of soft dusky grass and mist on the left third under a rose and plum sky. Rose and dusk pink dominate, violet only in the shadows, small glow-green and pale gold lights. Rich detailed foreground, softer layered distance. Composition reads well as a very wide shallow header: the largest shapes on the right third, a calm open left third. Painterly realism, evocative and beautiful. No characters, no creatures, no fairies, no insects with visible bodies, no buildings, no letters, no runes, no labels, no logos, no UI widgets, no rectangular picture frame, no watermark. Entire canvas opaque edge-to-edge scenery.
